# Bill Cassidy Watchdog File

Subject: Bill Cassidy, Republican, LA
Current office: U.S. Senate LA
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
Status: queued for hand research, priority 2. This file holds the roster facts, the office levers, and FEC pipeline data when the pipeline has run. It is not yet a finished Tier 2 profile.

## Race

Not on the 2026 ballot. delegation member not running
Roster note: lost May 16 closed GOP primary; Letlow is nominee

## Committee assignments

- Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources
- Senate Committee on Finance
- Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions (Chairman)
- Senate Committee on Veterans' Affairs

## Money

Not yet pulled. Run pipeline/fec_pull.py for federal subjects. Governors and other state candidates need hand research in the state campaign finance system.

## Levers this office controls

Template rows from the office and committee assignments. Each needs the specific decision, the date, and the subject position before it counts as a finding.

| Decision | Where it sits | Which blocs care |
|---|---|---|
| Confirmation votes for cabinet, judges, regulators and ambassadors | U.S. Senate | Every bloc with a regulator; Wall Street and banking; Crypto and finance; Health care and pharma |
| Filibuster and cloture votes on major legislation | U.S. Senate | Party and leadership |
| Federal lands and offshore leasing, mining, tribal affairs, water | Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources | Oil and gas; Utilities and energy; Sugar and agriculture |
| Federal lands leasing, energy policy, FERC and DOE nominations | Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources | Oil and gas; Utilities and energy; Utilities and data centers |
| Tax code, Medicare and Medicaid, trade and tariffs, Treasury and IRS nominations | Senate Committee on Finance | Billionaire megadonor; Wall Street and banking; Health care and pharma |
| Drug pricing, FDA, labor law, NLRB nominations, education | Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions (Chairman) | Health care and pharma; Labor unions; School choice and family |
| VA health care contracts and community care | Senate Committee on Veterans' Affairs | Health care and pharma |
